He mainly plays the [[small forward]] position, but he also has the ability to play as a [[shooting guard]] if needed. ==Professional career== ===Early years=== Osman was born in the Former Yugoslav Republic of Macedonia to an ethnic [[Turkish people|Turkish]] father and a [[Bosniaks|Bosniak]] mother.{{fact|date=September 2014}} He has a older brother [[Dzaner Osman|Dzaner]] who is also a basketball player. He started playing basketball with [[KK Bosna]] in 2001. He moved to the [[Anadolu Efes S.K.|Anadolu Efes]] junior team after his outstanding success with KK Bosna in 2007. Due to his paternal Turkish background he was immediately naturalized as a Turkish citizen due to Turkey's right of return laws and represents the Turkish National Team. ===Anadolu Efes=== Osman signed a youth team contract with Anadolu Efes in 2007. He played for the junior, star and youth teams of Efes. He was loaned for the 2011–12 season to [[Turkish Basketball Second League|TB2L]] team Pertevniyal Istanbul. In the summer of 2012, Osman signed a professional contract with [[Anadolu Efes S.K.|Anadolu Efes]]. ==Career statistics== {{Euroleague player statistics legend}} ===Euroleague=== {{Euroleague player
